rss: How does it affect me if share prices fall?
title: Why Toy Prices Might Change
story: When toy companies see stock prices fall, they might change their prices too. This can affect the cost of your favorite toys, like BLOK or PLSH.
storyBig: A drop in stock prices for toy companies can lead to adjustments in product pricing. This affects consumer spending and the overall market valuation of companies like BLOK or PLSH.
think: What would you do if your favorite toy's price went up?
bull: Lower stock prices might mean sales and discounts.
bear: Higher prices could make it harder to buy toys.

rss: Interest rates hiked to 4% in first increase in over three years
title: Interest Rates Rise, Costs Change
story: When interest rates go up, the cost of borrowing money goes up too. This means buying big things, like houses or cars, can become more expensive.
storyBig: An increase in interest rates makes loans more expensive, impacting consumer spending and saving behavior. This shift can affect industries like BIKE or DLVR, where financing plays a role.
think: How do you decide when something is too expensive to buy?
bull: Higher rates can mean more money earned from savings.
bear: It can cost more to borrow money for big purchases.
